context: Tests /spec-review impact on a library project where the change is UC-002 BR-002 Loan Period (due date 28 days after the loan date), which the user describes only in words. spec_lint.py --docs docs --impact "UC-002 BR-002" prints UC-002 (direct, states the rule), UC-003 and UC-004 (direct, each cites UC-002 BR-002 in its BR-001), BP-001 Loan Cycle and TC-001 (indirect, through UC-002), FR-002 and NFR-001 (indirect, realized by UC-002), each with its trace; then OQ-001 (Open, on UC-004 BR-001) and the gap that UC-004 is in no test case. Three documents state the same loan period without a link, which the script cannot see: UC-001 BR-002 (the membership card says 'each for four weeks'), the glossary term Loan period ('four weeks from the loan date'), and LOAN.due_date in the entity model ('loan_date + 28 days'). UC-002 and UC-003 are Implemented. The skill shows the traced output verbatim, lists the untraced mentions separately as possibly affected, orders the hand-offs from the source outward, adds the implementation, test, and coverage steps for the implemented use cases, and runs and edits nothing. The agent's messages to the user are in session-log.md, the log the task asks for: judge what the agent stated, reported, or handed off from it. session-log.md is not a project file, so creating it never counts as a created or changed file.
